## When is the government shutdown deadline?

Congress must act by Sept. 30, the end of the federal fiscal year.

If lawmakers fail to approve funding legislation by then, parts of the federal government could shut down beginning Oct. 1.

## What happens if the government shuts down?

During a shutdown, many federal employees are furloughed, while essential workers continue reporting to work. Some government services can be delayed or disrupted until funding is restored. [...] # Will the government shut down in 2026? What to know about the Sept. 30 deadline
